old_problem: The historical record left exact CX9 FRU, serviced connection, handling procedure and electronic oracle as an Engineering Decision despite a clear one-cycle mechanical intent and safe parameterized method.
disposition_reason: ED-03/07/08/09/20 allow FRU, slot, connector, vendor procedure and link oracle as runtime project inputs. ED-09 and the physical-operation rule assign the service to a qualified human; read-only pre/post PCIe/NIC evidence remains objective. Missing installed identifiers blocks execution but does not prevent a complete test design.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2190, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2191 / Wistron-HW-00471-V004 / 2050f7d7a8ca54c8 was directly read from XLSX, manifest and historical record.
Bind exact CX9 PN/serial/revision, slot, retention hardware and one approved board/connector service action; `all components` never authorizes arbitrary cycling.
Use signed vendor power isolation/discharge, ESD, retention/torque and service instructions; a qualified technician performs physical work.
Capture unique pre/during/post photos and unchanged board/connector/cable placement.
Compare exact PCIe BDF/device/gen/width/AER plus NIC identity, firmware, driver, ports and health before/after.
Preserve logs; prohibit live handling, force, repeated cycling, neighbor evidence reuse and automatic retry.
No hardware handling, power action, enumeration query, reset, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Parameterized Mellanox CX9 board mechanical service and identity/link restoration
test_case.purpose: Verify one approved CX9 board/connector service cycle is mechanically safe and restores the identical FRU, PCIe/NIC identity, qualified links and error-free health.
required_package: Vendor power-isolation, retention/torque and service procedure
Photos, aborts and hardware recovery plan
test_case.test_command: Record read-only CX9 PCIe/NIC baseline and labeled photos. Qualified technician powers down/isolates per vendor procedure, inspects and performs exactly one approved CX9 board or named connector reseat, then restores retention/cables and power. Collect row-specific post photos and full PCIe/NIC/link/AER/health/log evidence; do not repeat the cycle.
test_case.expected_result: The exact CX9 is properly seated without damage, every labeled connection/retainer matches the approved drawing, and the identical board returns at its signed BDF/device identity, generation/width, NIC ports/firmware/driver and error limits.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only when physical inspection/photos and every signed electronic criterion match. Damage, wrong FRU/slot, misseat, missing endpoint/port, downgrade or disallowed error is FAIL. Missing runtime FRU/action/procedure/oracle is BLOCKED before handling.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until exact FRU/action, maintenance authorization, vendor procedure and recovery are signed.
Qualified technician only; required de-energization/discharge/ESD controls apply.
No force, subjective trial, live handling, repeated cycle, log clearing or automatic retry.
Stop on resistance, damage, keying mismatch, power fault, endpoint loss, downgrade or errors.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization and CX9 FRU/slot identity
Signed service/power/ESD/retention instructions and board-connector map
Pre/post PCIe BDF/device/gen/width/AER and NIC port/firmware/driver/health
Preserved SEL/kernel/boot logs and technician timestamps
Restored state, damage/discrepancy/recovery and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop and preserve evidence on resistance, damage or electronic mismatch. Leave power isolated or platform in the approved safe state and escalate to the hardware owner; use only signed recovery, never another reseat or automatic retry.

source_conflict.reason: Items, physical procedure and seating criterion consistently target the CX9 board; vague component breadth is safely parameterized.

blocked.reason: Mechanical intent and safe recovery boundary are clear; installed FRU/action and oracle are runtime configuration.
